name: sherlock-holmes
description: Evidence-first incident investigation by trace ID using Grafana Loki logs and Grafana Tempo traces. Read-only: it reconstructs the timeline, finds the first anomalous event, separates cause from consequence and states its confidence and gaps.

grafana_url.title: Grafana URL
grafana_url.description: Your Grafana, e.g. https://your-stack.grafana.net. Leave blank if you reach Loki and Tempo directly instead, via the LOKI_URL and TEMPO_URL environment variables.

grafana_loki_uid.title: Loki datasource UID
grafana_loki_uid.description: UID of the Loki datasource in that Grafana. Don't know it? Leave this blank, finish the install, then ask Claude to run the trace-debug doctor: it lists every Loki and Tempo datasource with its UID.

grafana_tempo_uid.title: Tempo datasource UID
grafana_tempo_uid.description: UID of the Tempo datasource. The doctor lists this one too.

loki_selector.title: Loki stream selector
loki_selector.description: Which streams to search, e.g. {namespace="prod"}. Use labels your own Loki has; the doctor reports a sample of them. Never left as {} - the collector refuses to scan every stream.

loki_trace_filter.title: How logs carry the trace id
loki_trace_filter.description: substring searches the raw line and works with any format. metadata suits Loki 3 structured metadata. json parses JSON logs first.

loki_trace_field.title: Trace id field name
loki_trace_field.description: Only used by the metadata and json modes. Common values: trace_id, traceId, traceID.
